oracles: self-test: a fake subject leaking 2 MiB/h -> red; an fd not released -> red; one error -> red

acceptance.must: oracles/soak: h2load steady load (50% of measured 4-core throughput), PROXY + selector + crdb-less config (sqlite native route) + aegis-otlp sidecar; samples RSS/fds/tasks from /proc and metrics; RSS slope <= 1 MiB/h after 15 min warm-up; fds/tasks baseline +-5 after load; 0 errors; audit log verifies; --hours 24 record-only

notes: VM via ci/release/vm.sh start/stop (the gate runner handles it for the GO run; for acceptance start and stop it yourself).
